Average is computed as total cost divided by the number of cells visited in the path. public static float maxAverageOfPath(ArrayList> cost) { int n = cost.size(); long[][] dp = new long[n][n]; // Initialize the first cell dp[0][0] = cost.get(0).get(0); // Fill the first row for (int j = 1; j < n; j++) { dp[0][j] = dp[0][j - 1] + cost.get(0).get(j); } // Fill the first column for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) { dp[i][0] = dp[i - 1][0] + cost.get(i).get(0); } // Fill the rest of the matrix for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) { for (int j = 1; j < n; j++) { dp[i][j] = Math.min(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1]) + cost.get(i).get(j); } } // The maximum path sum is in the bottom-right cell long maxPathSum = dp[n - 1][n - 1]; // Calculate the number of cells visited in the path int numCellsVisited = n * 2 - 1; // Return the maximum average return (float) maxPathSum / numCellsVisited; } }
